_comment: Initial Dinacharya activities (loaded by a migration; edit them in the admin afterwards). start/end: {anchor: sunrise|sunset|clock, offset_minutes, clock, fallback_clock}. {dosha} in text = the user's dosha. season_overrides / dosha_overrides replace fields for that season / dosha. above_temperature_c: only include when it is hotter than this.

templates.title: Rise with the day
templates.description: Wake before sunrise; sit quietly for a few minutes.
reasons: Brahma muhurta is associated with a calm mind (classical timing).

templates.title: Warm water + tongue cleaning
templates.description: Drink warm water; clean the tongue gently.
reasons: Warm water supports digestion and hydration.

templates.title: Self-massage (coconut oil)
templates.description: A short abhyanga with coconut oil before bathing.
reasons: Coconut oil is seasonally balancing for your climate.

templates.title: Movement / exercise
templates.description: Moderate exercise until mild perspiration; stop before exhaustion.
reasons: Exercise supports kapha balance and digestion.

templates.title: Main meal
templates.description: Eat your largest meal now, when digestive fire (agni) is strongest. Eat mindfully, until comfortably full.
reasons: Midday is the classical peak of agni.

templates.title: Light dinner
templates.description: Prefer warm, freshly-cooked meals and a 3-hour gap before sleep.
reasons: A light evening meal supports restful sleep.

varsha.description: In the monsoon, digestion is weaker: prefer light, warm, well-spiced food.

grishma.description: In peak summer, favor cool, light meals and hydration.

templates.title: Sunset walk
templates.description: A short evening walk; reduce stimulation as light fades.
reasons: Matching activity to the light cycle steadies the mind.

templates.title: Afternoon rest
templates.description: Very hot weather: rest in a cool, shaded room; hydrate.
reasons: Heat stress is managed by scheduling rest during peak heat.

templates.title: Wind down
templates.description: Dim lights, avoid screens, light reading or quiet reflection.
reasons: Reduced stimulation before sleep improves nidra (restorative sleep).

templates.title: Sleep
templates.description: Aim for 7-8 hours of sleep. Your routine is tuned to a {dosha} constitution.
reasons: Kapha-predominant people often need earlier sleep; pitta later.
